title: Dual-Cloud Concept Cover & Residual Preservation
intuition: Uses two explicit learned particle clouds to test whether adversarial updates match both concept poles (pole_rel_err <= 0.20) while preserving orthogonal residual content (content_kept >= 0.75) with low leakage (leak_ratio <= 0.20).
failure_mode: Adversarial forces collapse the residual content subspace onto the concept axis or cross-contaminate the positive and negative clouds.
protocol_notes: Explicit particle_cloud prior exception (sigma=0.0) using two host-declared clouds and host jitter.
